From 7150850146ebfa4ca998f653f264b8df6f7f85be Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Srinivasan Shanmugam <srinivasan.shanmugam@amd.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 13:41:18 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amdgpu: Fix fence put before wait in
 amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib() submits a GPU job and gets a fence
from amdgpu_ib_schedule(). This fence is used to wait for job
completion.

Currently, the code drops the fence reference using dma_fence_put()
before calling dma_fence_wait().

If dma_fence_put() releases the last reference, the fence may be
freed before dma_fence_wait() is called. This can lead to a
use-after-free.

Fix this by waiting on the fence first and releasing the reference
only after dma_fence_wait() completes.

Fixes the below:
drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_amdkfd.c:697 amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib() warn: passing freed memory 'f' (line 696)

Fixes: 9ae55f030dc5 ("drm/amdgpu: Follow up change to previous drm scheduler change.")
Cc: Felix Kuehling <Felix.Kuehling@amd.com>
Cc: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Cc: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Cc: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Srinivasan Shanmugam <srinivasan.shanmugam@amd.com>
Reviewed-by: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
(cherry picked from commit 8b9e5259adc385b61a6590a13b82ae0ac2bd3482)

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_amdkfd.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_amdkfd.c
index 40c22438b1d2..4f27c75abedb 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_amdkfd.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_amdkfd.c
@@ -692,9 +692,9 @@ int amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib(struct amdgpu_device *adev,
 		goto err_ib_sched;
 	}
 
-	/* Drop the initial kref_init count (see drm_sched_main as example) */
-	dma_fence_put(f);
 	ret = dma_fence_wait(f, false);
+	/* Drop the returned fence reference after the wait completes */
+	dma_fence_put(f);
 
 err_ib_sched:
 	amdgpu_job_free(job);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File Modified: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_amdkfd.c`

- **Location**: In function `amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib`, around lines 692–695.
- **Changes**:
  1. Removed the call `dma_fence_put(f);` that was placed **before** `dma_fence_wait(f, false);`.
  2. Moved `dma_fence_put(f);` to **after** `dma_fence_wait(f, false);`.
  3. Updated the associated comment to reflect the new order: now reads “Drop the returned fence reference after the wait completes” instead of the previous comment about dropping the initial kref_init count.

### Relationship Between Modifications

The change is confined to a single file and a single code block. It involves swapping two operations in the execution sequence to fix a use-after-free bug. Previously, releasing the fence reference (`dma_fence_put`) before waiting (`dma_fence_wait`) could cause the fence object to be freed prematurely. The corrected order ensures the wait completes first, then the reference is safely released. There are no cross-file dependencies.

Root cause:
In amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib(), the dma_fence_put() call was placed before dma_fence_wait(), potentially freeing the fence object before the wait operation, causing a use-after-free.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
dma_fence_put(f);
ret = dma_fence_wait(f, false);
Reason:
Calling dma_fence_put(f) before dma_fence_wait(f, false) can release the last reference to the fence object, causing it to be freed. The subsequent dma_fence_wait() then accesses freed memory, resulting in a use-after-free bug.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
ret = dma_fence_wait(f, false);
dma_fence_put(f);
Reason:
By waiting on the fence first with dma_fence_wait() and then releasing the reference with dma_fence_put(), the fence object remains valid during the wait operation. This prevents the use-after-free and ensures safe memory management.
